note: ADR 0823, 2026-11-27, done: export_view writes a view as one self-contained HTML page (no script, a CSP of default-src 'none', the Studio's stylesheets inline, fields and a case's mesh as inline SVG, provenance per panel) whose every value equals the open Studio's on X1 to X5 with no request beyond its own file; the push's E1 miss was the mutated rcfd-mcp left by M1's expect-fail build, reproduced to the digit in a fresh copy, and M1's command now builds in target/mutation.

follow_ups.title: The exported page writes a monitor's last step as the Studio does, and the e2e of ADR 0823 runs whole
follow_ups.acceptance: Every limit not stated here is registered in the ADR before the run. The page of export_view writes each step and count as an integer, as the Studio shows it; the e2e of ADR 0823 (E1 to E6 on X1 to X5) holds every value of the registered comparison and makes no request beyond the page's own file.

follow_ups.title: The Studio's Archivo fonts embedded in an exported page
follow_ups.acceptance: Every limit not stated here is registered in the ADR before the run. The page of export_view carries the Archivo fonts the Studio shows (400, 500, 700) as data: fonts written by the Studio's build, with no network fetch, and the page's computed font in the e2e of ADR 0823 is Archivo with no font installed.
